card.statement:
For $\mathscr{F}_{1}$ and $\mathscr{F}_{2}$ in $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ , we have canonical isomorphisms

$i^{\circ}\bigl(\tau^{\circ}(\mathscr{F}_{1})\star_{X}\tau^{\circ}(\mathscr{F}_{2})\bigr)\cong\tau^{\circ}(\mathscr{F}_{1}\star\mathscr{F}_{2})\cong i^{\bullet}\bigl(\tau^{\circ}(\mathscr{F}_{1})\star_{X}\tau^{\circ}(\mathscr{F}_{2})\bigr).$
card.label: Lemma 7.8

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
